author: Docjaded
body:
Bide your time, get stronger.  Eventually you'll get to a point where you can dish it out just as well if not better.  Also he have might quit by then.  


The longer he stays away from an area, the weaker he will be in a fight to defend it so target those first

body:
you are supposed to fight him. and take your areas back..

are you too weak? get stronger. he also had to work to gain Beowulf..

author: Vik_the_Thracian
body: One guy owns almost all of my city. It is what it is... Territories aren't really worth fighting for anyways, the rewards are small even for the lower tiers. Territories are more for bragging rights than getting some sort of serious income at the moment (nothing against this BTW). There's nothing stopping you from exploring, though.

author: mrasianjew
body:
<insert Homer bush meme here>

Well, sorry you're upset over....having difficulty against a player that's multiple tiers higher, and probably has spent enough time to get decently equipped....it is part of the game. 

Probably for the best. If this minor of a thing upset you, I'd have hated to see what would have happened when you crossed paths with a top 10 competitive. 

Some days, you're the bug, some days, you're the windshield. While I prefer the windshield life, occasionally it does one good to be humbled as a bug. 

Good luck in your search for a game with the depth of Orna.

author: ddavidm1
body: Sometimes it happens... But don't forget that this person invested time and effort to go to the town you're living in... When you kick him out, he will be furious probably... ;) Good luck!

author: Hungry-Self556
body: Use poison , he will gradually die every turn , even if it take sometime

author: Enough-Bike7525
body:
When I first started playing Orna a few years back, there was a guy who was 13th in the world who lived in my town and owned everything. I made it my mission to get stronger and be a thorn in his side. I finally got to where I am today and even though he's still ranked higher than me, I can take their territory with ease. It's been a very fulfilling rivalry and hopefully they enjoy the competition as much as I have.

Also considering area control is a minor component of the game, I wouldn't get too upset about it.

author: Widogeist
body: Area control is a very small part of the game, don't stress about it.  There's nothing you can do as a lower tier player other than hope they don't have dot immunity gear and slowly kill them with dots.  Focus on other aspects of the game, play your character and get stronger, and eventually you'll be able to kill them.

author: jewpapa
body: Ok I wanna explain myself here. my buddy and I were out bar hopping playing the game and he basically said he's going to quit playing because there is no incentive to continue playing when characters like this control the entire area with no means of knocking them off. I was upset that I've been trying to find players to play with and they get discouraged to play. A couple of drinks compounded with frustration lead to this post.

author: MasterKaein
body:
I have the same problem. ONE GUY controls most of Florida. *ONE GUY*. And his build is absolutely insane. I can't even scratch him.

I wish there was some sort of very slow deteriorating effect if they don't visit an area for awhile, making it to where they'll be weak enough to supplant from a location. That way they can't just take a day and drive around conquering everything everywhere and then become impossible to remove, which is clearly what's happening here.
